body: Hook endpoint is a hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 reader over tokio (POST only, Content-Length only, Transfer-Encoding and repeated Content-Length rejected per RFC 9112 6.3, 8 KiB head, 1 MiB body, 2 s deadline, Connection: close, lingering close). Alternative: add hyper/axum (outside the agreed crate set, far more surface than one endpoint).

Hook client is a raw tokio TcpStream POST under one overall timeout, no retry loop. Alternative: reqwest (needs the blocking feature or a client with rustls root setup; start-up cost counts against the 1.5 s SessionEnd budget).

Event id = 32 hex from two std RandomState-keyed SipHash draws over counter+clock+pid; HookPost::new mints it, re-sending the same HookPost reuses it. Alternative: add rand/uuid crate (outside the agreed set; uniqueness, not secrecy, is required).

Dedup remembers an event id only after try_send to the hub channel succeeded; a full channel answers 503 without remembering, so a re-send is delivered. Alternative: remember on receipt (a 503 would turn the re-send into a silent drop).

Non-loopback listening needs only an explicit CCTG_AGENT_LISTEN/CCTG_HOOK_LISTEN ip:port (host names rejected) plus a startup warning. Alternative: an extra CCTG_ALLOW_REMOTE flag (second knob for the same explicit choice).

Config.hub_secret is Option<Secret> and `cctg hub` fails at start when it is unset, like projects_dir. Alternative: make it required in Config::from_vars (rewrites every existing config test fixture).

Messages are versioned per line: decode parses a serde_json::Value, checks v, then type against Kinds::KINDS, then fields; errors carry no input. Alternative: #[serde(other)] Unknown variant (cannot round-trip, and serde error texts quote input values, which may be the secret).

Header field values with any ASCII control byte except HTAB are rejected with 400 (RFC 9110 5.5 MUST reject-or-replace CR/LF/NUL); chosen over replacing with SP because the only client is our own hook, which never sends them.

subtle is declared in [workspace.dependencies] (subtle = "2.6") and used as subtle.workspace = true, matching how every other cctg dependency is declared; alternative was reviewer-1 direct crate-level version pin.

Hook client keeps a single concatenated write of head+body; PLAN_V2 split into two write_all calls was dropped because nothing about the concat copy is wrong and the task says change only what is verifiably wrong.

Tried a pipelining test that demands exactly 400 for two requests in one write; rejected because whether the first read stops at the first body depends on TCP segmentation, so the test asserts "at most one event, and an event only with 204" instead.

Verdict NEEDS_WORK, not FAIL: read_line cancel-unsafety in select! (repro 2/2 fail) is a local fix (resumable read_line or per-connection reader task); alternative FAIL rejected because the rest of the contract (auth order, strict HTTP, dedup, loopback, log hygiene) verified correct.

First qa_hook_timing_budget run failed with Status(503): the probe never drained the 8-slot hook queue, so the 9th new event hit the full channel. Probe bug, not a product bug; fixed by draining rx in a background task (worst of 20 POSTs then 0.8 ms).

Verdict SHIP: every acceptance criterion and every fixer claim reproduced by independent probes; the two findings (Unicode trim accepts NBSP around header values; a hub consumer stalled >5 s makes the agent write time out and lose one in-flight message) are nit/latent and do not violate the spec. Alternative NEEDS_FIXES rejected: neither finding is reachable with today's only client (cctg hook) and drain_ingress, and both are recorded for TASK-011.
